description: Search bike4mind.com blog posts. Multi-word queries are matched term by term across title, tags, summary and full body — so natural phrasing works ("open core licensing") and you do not have to guess a post's exact wording. Results are ranked: posts matching every term come first, partial matches follow rather than being discarded. Omit q to list the most recent posts. Returns compact listings with URLs.

q.description: words to search for, in any order; matched across title, tags, summary and body

name: search_blog_posts
